correctness.rationale: Atomic decomposition is an ell_1 sum of ell_p fibers. Weakly null sequences have uniform coordinate-tail tightness by gliding hump; coordinatewise ell_p weak nullity and p-power splitting imply limit of each ||u_j±v_n,j||_p equals (||u_j||_p^p+s_j^p)^(1/p). Minkowski yields atomic lower bound (a^p+s^p)^(1/p), and the diffuse two-sign triangle bound is max{b,t-s}. The minimizer of this sum over 0<=s<=t is s=max(0,t-b). Nonatomic Rademacher-type signs and ell_p unit vectors e_n furnish weakly null sequences with norm exactly t and attain the piecewise bound, including a=0,b=0,t=0,t=b. Infinite-dimensionality 1<p<infinity and atomlessness for the sign construction are essential.
